cells.gaps: No source found names a body set up or named to carry out the strategy: a council, office, agency, committee or ministry unit. The December 2025 reports state only that the 2026-2035 roadmap was validated, and in September 2026 the higher-education ministry named finalising the national strategy document as a next step.
cells.note: The digital ministry's own 2025 report says a three-phase AI strategy was adopted, and no later source says it was withdrawn or replaced, so stage 3 holds; no body is named to carry it out, so not stage 4.
